title: Coverage Decision and Appeal Deadlines for the Special Needs Plans Category
content:
The time within which an organisation determination on a Special Needs Plans package must be decided, the shorter time where the request is expedited, the window within which a reconsideration may be filed, and whether Medicare and Medicaid appeals are handled as one integrated process, are fixed by the package.

| Plan benefit package | A standard organisation determination decided within, calendar days | An expedited organisation determination decided within, hours | A reconsideration filed within, calendar days after the adverse determination | Medicare and Medicaid appeals handled as one integrated process |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Essentials (HMO D-SNP) | 14 | 72 | 60 | yes |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Advantage (HMO D-SNP) | 14 | 72 | 60 | yes |
| Ridgecrest Heart Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | 14 | 72 | 60 | no |
| Ridgecrest Diabetes Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | 14 | 72 | 60 | no |
| Ridgecrest Lung Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | 14 | 72 | 60 | no |
| Ridgecrest Institutional Care (HMO I-SNP) | 14 | 72 | 60 | yes |

## Basis of each column

The first column is the calendar days within which a standard organisation determination must be decided, and the second the hours within which an expedited organisation determination must be decided. The third is the calendar days after an adverse determination within which a reconsideration may be filed. The last records whether Medicare and Medicaid appeals are handled as one integrated process.

## Points of judgement

**Do the three deadlines differ between packages in the Special Needs Plans category?** They do not. Every package carries 14 calendar days for a standard determination, 72 hours for an expedited one and a filing window of 60 calendar days.

**Which packages carry an integrated appeal process?** Ridgecrest Dual Complete Essentials (HMO D-SNP), Ridgecrest Dual Complete Advantage (HMO D-SNP) and Ridgecrest Institutional Care (HMO I-SNP). The three chronic condition packages do not.
